model: Finite-collar/weak-exterior magnetic-loop MONOPOLE state fixed point; nonspherical source not closed

parameters.separation_convention: Fixed once so the prior single-delay1.2 corresponds to the shortest leading path in its old leading clock; not a measured or solved physical separation

equations.period: Lnu=2*x_b+[d*f(nu)-2*rho_b+Shapiro_nu]/A; common A=N100/b100; rho_b=Rb-1 with measured finite-collar coordinate discrepancy
equations.state: Omega²=integral_0^2 dnu/2*(2pi/Lnu)²; collar recomputed at each trialOmega²
equations.weak_exterior: Fixed point-magnetic paths, unit leading mass per mouth, dt=(1+2U)dl. Shapiro=4 integral_0^sc speed*(1/rhat_plus+1/rhat_minus) ds. Finite flat-cap excess is bounded separately.
equations.endpoint: rho is isotropic, not areal; exact point-path cap root is reused. The finite collar isotropic relation d(logrho)/dl=1/R is integrated with one anchored normalization.
equations.leading: Recovers z*(meanOmega²(delta/z)-1)=3 with ell_v=4/(pi*alpha),z=A/ell_v,delta=d/ell_v at leading order.

scope: Only the spherical average and its finite-collar clock feedback are closed in this composite approximation. Angular state spread, omitted full4D polarization, companion metric, weak-metric magnetic-path deformation, exact junction, state preparation, pulse evolution, stability and formation remain unresolved. Cutoff agreement is not a physical accuracy bound. No manufactured independent channel clocks or renormalization of discarded channels.
sources: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1409.3743 (weak optical metric; paths here are prescribed magnetic curves)
Existing magnetic_return_path_checks/optical_matching_checks and our new same-source finite-collar feedback

verification.scope: Positive periods, normalized full flux weights, bracketed roots, 64/128 quadrature refinement, Cartesian-path and analytic-axis cross-checks. Not certified errors or a stability test. Angular coefficients are source projections, not metric responses.
